question: Can low-degree spectral history improve the frozen multivariate L12 forecast after validation-only selection and seasonal fallback?
level: External empirical forecast experiment, not native Adva or a four-dimensional tile result
prior_exposure: Both validation and development intervals informed earlier work; the current design follows exposed diagnostics. No new untouched holdout or as-of reanalysis is claimed.
representation: Existing 2698 L12 coefficients; low-degree indices l<=6 (778 coefficients) are a part of L12, not the independently fitted L6 model. Remaining 1920 fine-degree coefficients stay in the represented state.
normalization: Frozen training-only L12 monthly climatology and per-channel RMS coefficient scales, independently recomputed against 1979-2014 arrays.
features: 64 leading EOF directions of training-only low-degree normalized anomalies; concatenate oldest-to-newest histories or newest-to-oldest consistently; no values later than forecast origin.
learner: Separate direct ridge map for each lead 1..6; predict only low-degree target anomalies, blend with frozen L12 low-degree forecast; retain frozen L12 fine-degree anomalies. Fit pairs and all history frames are inside training.
validation_objective: For each physical scalar/vector channel, mean full observed-domain squared error from its frozen Gram and truncation residual, divided by its L12 TRAINING full seasonal error. Humidity is log-space for this selection only. Equal channel and lead weight.
selection: Choose one global penalty/blend within each history length using validation only. Then for each entire channel, choose among incumbent, seasonal baseline, globally selected 1-frame and globally selected 3-frame candidates using mean validation error over all six leads. Require at least 2 percent improvement over incumbent to switch. Ties favor incumbent, seasonal, 1-frame, 3-frame in that order. No per-lead or per-region model selection.
physical_evaluation: Full native-domain MSE; inverse-log physical humidity explicitly evaluated against raw native arrays. Aggregate with frozen L6 training physical normalizers from previous report. Also retain transformed-space metrics and global 500 hPa vector scores.
regional_diagnostic: Same three fixed 9x9 native patches and leads 1 and 6 as Research 0229, reported only after selection; no regional fitting.

promotion_gate.additional: Finite forecast, positive humidity, chronological isolation, exact saved-model replay, no Xue quantization clamping; otherwise publish clearly marked research candidate without making it default. Gate cannot change selected parameters.

protected: Original L6/L12 forecasts, data pointers and public bytes retained
No testing-interval refit, weight tuning or hidden retry
Data authenticity of the whole pipeline remains unverified; no independent source replication
Historical origin and monthly cadence visible on website; no typhoon or ENSO attribution
External dependencies and source observations not copied into Adva
Native authority, paused Lorentzian work and library obligations unchanged
checks: Recompute frozen training climatology and scale
Replay frozen incumbent coefficients against archived backtest
Train pairs and history indices confined to training
Forecast-origin future poisoning leaves predictions unchanged
Reconstruct saved new model in a fresh process
Native wind full-domain scoring agrees with Gram accounting
All Xue bundles decode and Zarr agrees; valid web model switching

budget.enforcement: Parent timeout, worker POSIX CPU/address-space/file-size limits, fixed candidate counts and persistent outside-repository launch ledger; no automatic retries. A failure repair requires a new contract and retained failure.
